events.label: Federal election
events.desc: AfD enters the Bundestag as the third-largest party while Union and SPD both lose heavily

events.label: EU election
events.desc: Greens finish second after the Rezo video and the climate protests and gain about 6 points while Union and SPD lose

events.label: COVID-19
events.desc: The pandemic reaches Germany and the first nationwide contact ban takes effect while the Union rallies behind the government and gains about 8 points

events.label: Federal election
events.desc: SPD wins narrowly under Olaf Scholz and the Union records its worst federal result up to then at 24.1 percent

events.label: Ukraine invasion
events.desc: Russia invades Ukraine and Scholz announces the Zeitenwende with the Greens gaining while the Left and AfD lose

events.label: Ampel collapses
events.desc: Scholz dismisses finance minister Lindner and the coalition breaks apart which leads to the snap election

events.label: Federal election
events.desc: Union wins with 28.5 percent and the AfD doubles to 20.8 while FDP and BSW miss the threshold

events.label: AfD wins Saxony-Anhalt
events.desc: AfD wins 43.8 percent in Saxony-Anhalt, the strongest result for any party there since reunification, while the CDU falls to 17.2 and the Union slides to record lows nationally

BE.label: State election
BE.desc: SPD wins under Franziska Giffey; the election is later annulled over organisational failures

BE.label: State election
BE.desc: Repeat election: CDU wins with 28.2 percent under Kai Wegner, ahead of SPD and Greens at 18.4 percent each

BE.label: Left wins Berlin
BE.desc: Die Linke wins with about 25.7 percent (preliminary), its first win in Berlin, ahead of the CDU at 18.8 and the AfD at 16.3; SPD falls to 12.1

BB.label: State election
BB.desc: SPD stays strongest under Dietmar Woidke; AfD second with 23.5 percent

BB.label: State election
BB.desc: SPD narrowly stays strongest with 30.9 percent, ahead of the AfD at 29.2; Greens and Left miss out

MV.label: State election
MV.desc: SPD wins with 39.6 percent under Manuela Schwesig; AfD second with 16.7 percent

MV.label: AfD wins Mecklenburg-Vorpommern
MV.desc: AfD wins with 38.2 percent (preliminary), ahead of the SPD at 35.5; the CDU falls below the threshold at 4.9 and leaves the Landtag

ST.label: State election
ST.desc: CDU wins with 37.1 percent under Reiner Haseloff; AfD second with 20.8 percent

ST.label: AfD wins Saxony-Anhalt
ST.desc: AfD wins 43.8 percent in Saxony-Anhalt (preliminary result), more than double its 2021 result, while the CDU falls to 17.2 percent

SN.label: State election

SN.label: State election
SN.desc: CDU narrowly stays strongest with 31.9 percent; AfD second with 30.6 percent

TH.label: State election
TH.desc: AfD becomes the strongest party with 32.8 percent (preliminary), its first time first in any state
